QuestInfo.name: Following the Traces of Contamination
QuestInfo.0: Master Tai Yu is busy talking to the researchers, and is unaware that you and Gaon have arrived. Go to #b#m410007020##k and talk to Master Tai Yu again.
QuestInfo.1: You talk to Master Tai Yu in #b#m410007020##k.
QuestInfo.2: You heard from Master Tai Yu about the problems that occurred in Shangri-La. You decided to help patrol Shangri-La for the elders, who were busy taking care of the appeals from the outside world.
